what_this_is: The owner's manual team notes for the NFL picks (both models). Only the owner adds, changes or removes a note, case by case; add one with results/team_notes.py set, never by editing past events. Each event keeps the time it was set: a note only counts for games that kick off after that time. Points go on the noted team's predicted margin (negative docks the team). See results/team_notes.py for how the points move each model's numbers and how the notes are graded.

unreliable.label: Unreliable
unreliable.owner_definition: Unreliable is a manual option that is on a case by case basis and it doesn't only consist of losing a game. It's when a team doesn't want to win or appears lazy / their prior results were a result of luck not effort. Basically losing games they shouldn't have lost.
